title: Star Panoptic Quality: Selectively Evaluating Split and Merged Instances
abstract: arXiv:2611.27913v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Detecting individual instances is crucial for many segmentation problems. However, expert instance annotations are often unavailable, so instances are approximated heuristically (e.g., as connected components of semantic maps), which can merge touching objects or split fragmented ones. Even when expert annotations exist, expert disagreement or structural delineation biases can yield split or merged reference instances, corresponding to over- or under-segmentation, respectively. Panoptic Quality (PQ) and related metrics capture both segmentation and detection quality while weighting all instances equally, regardless of size. Yet when the references are biased, these metrics can neither detect split or merged instances nor distinguish valid from invalid overor under-segmentation. translated_title: 星形全景质量：选择性评估分裂与合并的实例
translated_abstract: 检测单个实例对于许多分割问题至关重要。然而，专家实例标注往往不可用，因此实例通常通过启发式方法进行近似（例如，作为语义图的连通分量），这可能合并相互接触的物体或分裂破碎的物体。即使存在专家标注，专家之间的分歧或结构勾画偏差也可能产生分裂或合并的参考实例，分别对应于过度分割或欠分割。全景质量及其相关指标在评估分割和检测质量时对所有实例进行等权重加权，而不考虑实例大小。然而，当参考标注存在偏差时，这些指标既无法检测分裂或合并的实例，也无法区分有效与无效的过度分割或欠分割。我们提出了星形全景质量，这是一种新颖的评估框架，通过两个步骤弥合了这一差距：首先，我们构建了一种所谓的星形森林……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了新型评估框架StarPQ（星形全景质量），通过构建星形森林等方法，能够检测存在偏差的参考标注中分裂或合并的实例，并区分有效与无效的过度分割和欠分割。
en_tdlr: Star Panoptic Quality (StarPQ) is a novel evaluation framework that detects split or merged instances in biased reference annotations and distinguishes valid from invalid over- and under-segmentation.
